featured_reviews.name: Dhanashree Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Aagaman Multi Cuisine Restaurant with four friends, and we had a great dining experience overall.

We ordered Chicken Koliwada and Paneer Kalimiri for starters, followed by Butter Chicken, Paneer Butter Masala, Butter Naan, and Garlic Butter Naan for the main course. The food was delicious, and every dish was well-prepared and flavorful.

The service was excellent, and the staff was attentive throughout our visit. We particularly appreciated that when our naans started getting cold because of the air conditioning, the staff gladly reheated them for us without any hesitation. The ambience and overall vibe of the restaurant were also very pleasant and made for an enjoyable meal.

The only minor issue was that we had ordered 3 Butter Naans and 2 Garlic Naans, but were served 2 Butter Naans and 3 Garlic Naans instead. It wasn't a major problem, but it was a small mix-up in the order.

Other than that, everything—from the food and service to the ambience—was excellent. Would definitely visit again.

We're glad you and your friends had a great time at Aagaman, and it's wonderful to hear the Chicken Koliwada, Paneer Kalimiri, and Butter Chicken hit the mark. featured_reviews.name: Manasi mayekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dont even deserve any stars.

Extremely disappointing experience at Panka Fast Virar.

I had made a reservation one day in advance for 7 people and clearly informed the restaurant about the number of guests. However, when we arrived at our scheduled time, we were offered a table meant for only 4 people.

When we pointed out that we were a group of 7, the staff repeatedly insisted that we "adjust" even though the table and seating arrangement clearly could not accommodate us comfortably. The chairs themselves were large, making it physically impossible to seat 7 people at that table.

What made the situation worse was that the restaurant was largely empty at the time, yet we were told that other tables were reserved for "regular customers." If reservations from new customers are not treated equally, then what is the point of accepting them in the first place?

After much argument, we were offered a larger table, but were then informed that if another group arrived, they might seat additional people at our table. This was completely unacceptable, especially considering we had made a reservation in advance.

The most disappointing part was the attitude of the staff. Instead of trying to resolve the issue professionally, they were rude, dismissive, and even laughed during the discussion. At no point did anyone make a genuine effort to understand our concern or find a reasonable solution.

Eventually, our group decided to leave and dine elsewhere. Surprisingly, even after seeing seven customers walk out because of poor service and poor handling of a reservation, nobody from the staff or management bothered to stop us, apologize, or attempt to make things right. It was clear that customer satisfaction was not a priority.

A reservation should mean something. If tables are only being kept aside for regular customers, then the restaurant should be honest about that instead of accepting reservations they have no intention of honoring properly.

Overall, one of the most unprofessional restaurant experiences I've had. Poor reservation management, rude staff, preferential treatment for regular customers, and complete indifference when customers decide to leave. I would not recommend this place based on my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sumitha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Misleading, Overpriced & Utterly Disappointing

This place is a complete letdown. I ordered the Moroccan Sizzler based on what was clearly mentioned on the menu, but what I was served was something else altogether. Paneer was added without any mention or consent, the rice tasted weird and borderline foul, and the dish was simply inedible.

They served two pieces of so called “falafel” that tasted exactly like dal vada—absolutely nothing like real falafel. The menu mentioned pita bread, which was missing. When questioned, the staff casually said it wasn’t available. No prior information, no apology, no replacement, no compensation. Instead, they thought throwing in paneer would magically fix their false advertising.

The staff clearly don’t understand their own menu—can’t pronounce items, can’t explain ingredients, can’t communicate unavailability. Hygiene is questionable too: dirty table water bottles and a clear push to force customers into buying packaged water.

This place is all hype, zero substance. Overpriced, misleading, and not even remotely worth it. Do not come here for any international food or any special occasion—you’ll pay for expectations and walk out disappointed.

I’m against food wastage but this place made me to make an exception!

Avoid.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sumitha Gupta,

We're shocked and saddened by your terrible experience 😔. Your feedback on the Moroccan Sizzler is noted, and we apologize for the discrepancies in the dish. The addition of paneer without consent was unacceptable, and we'll investigate the kitchen staff. We also regret the missing pita bread and poor communication from our staff. Your concerns about hygiene and menu representation are being looked into. We'll ensure our staff is trained better and communicate clearly about menu items. We want to make it right and invite you to revisit us with a complimentary meal. Please DM us to discuss further.

Best regards,
ICCHAPURTI PURE VEG RESTAURANT Team

The Bunker is an amazing new restaurant and bar recently opened in Agashi, Virar. The concept and theme of this restaurant is based on Indian defence forces. As the name suggests it really feels like a bunker from inside with all the guns, designs, wallart, bunker sized window even the tissue holder is uniquely made which will all keep you mesmerized.

Now coming to the food, we tried "Dahi ke Shole" and I must tell you it was so dammn yummy. Koyla Chicken was another such dish which had unique taste made of their own made garam masala. Bunker special kebabs (stuffed with chicken) is also an amazing dish you can try. Chicken Gavran handi is also recommended by me, it has an authentic taste to it.

The service was top notch which was not expected from newly opened restaurant. The owners are very friendly and are working really hard to improve. Would surely love to visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Indie Cuisine
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Bunker is a fine dine restaurant in the Agashi area of Virar West. We went here for lunch on weekend. The place wasn't much crowded. They did proper sanitation and temperature check before handing us the menu. The ambience of this place caught my eye. They have a theme which pays tribute to Indian Army.

Now let's talk about what food we had :-
🍢 STARTERS
1. Chicken Koyla
2. Chicken Kalimiri Kebab
3. Chicken & Cheese Garlic Kebab
The Kebabs were presented very nicely and were amazing in taste. The first starter was okayish. The quantity felt a bit less looking at the price.
🍴MAINS
1. Murg Musallam
2. Butter Roti
3. Jeera Rice & Dal Tadka
The Murg Musallam was the best part of the day. The quantity was sufficient for 5 people and had big juicy pieces of chicken. The dal rice was a perfect way to end the meal.
